annotations.title: Embed CII XML into a PDF

description:
Combine a visual PDF you already have with CII XML into one Factur-X PDF/A-3.

    Use for an existing visual invoice; use generate_invoice to render invoice data or produce UBL.
    Match the PDF's parties, lines and totals to xml yourself: check examines only XML and cannot detect
    disagreement with the visible PDF. The embedded profile comes from xml; neither check nor language
    changes it. language does not translate the PDF.

    Invalid input or failed rules return a tool error with no file; rule errors include ids. For a
    findings report use validate_invoice. Success returns a JSON summary (profile, size_bytes, warning
    count) and a base64 PDF/A-3 resource. Requires a plan key; success consumes one document, errors
    consume none. Nothing is stored or sent.

check.description: XML validation rules: fr-ctc adds French BR-FR-* to EN 16931; base uses EN 16931 only.
check.title: Check

language.description: Language written in the PDF metadata: fr (default) or en.

pdf_base64.description: Standard base64 of PDF bytes starting with %PDF-. Not a URL or data-URI.
pdf_base64.title: Pdf Base64

xml.description: Unencoded CII XML text (Factur-X / EN 16931); UBL is not supported.
xml.title: Xml
